messages:
Maya: PSA: kitchen update — do not microwave artisanal little round pastries without supervision. trust me.
Liam: what happened? did someone invent a new kind of snack?
Hank: i brought a box of macaroons for the meetup. i turned my back for ~30s and then... chaos.
Zoe: (uploads photo: tiny crater in plate, gooey filling everywhere) https://imgur.com/example
Liam: that looks like the aftermath of a pastry meteor strike.
Hank: i misread 10s as 10m on the ancient office microwave. my bad.
Maya: note to future selves: microwave timer UI should come with a built-in fact-checker.
Reacji Bot: added :macaroon: emoji (reaction: :eyes:)
Zoe: proposing we canonize this as "The Macaroon Incident" and assign Hank an honorary nickname.
Liam: options: "Hankaroon", "Microwave Mike", "Pastry Phantom"
Hank: i will accept Hankaroon or Pastry Phantom. i refuse to be Microwave Mike though. that sounds like a villain.
Maya: humble suggestion: stickers + a small plaque above the microwave that says "BE KIND TO MACAROONS"
Zoe: and a line in office handbook under kitchen etiquette: "If you can't set a timer properly, ask a colleague or submit dessert to communal supervision."
Liam: poll: sticker (:thumbsup:), plaque (:tada:), handbook line (:heart:), tattoo (no_entry_sign)
Maya: :thumbsup:
Hank: :heart: (for the handbook line. also patch maybe?)
Zoe: :tada:
Reacji Bot: pinned message to #random: "Macaroon Incident - lore entry"
Liam: design volunteer? i'll mock up a sticker: a tiny macaroon wearing safety goggles with the caption "Hankaroon: Do Not Overheat"
Maya: perfect. we should do a batch of 40 stickers. hand them out at next all-hands as a joke onboarding gift.
Hank: surprisingly honored. will bring unheated pastries for the ceremony.
Zoe: future onboarding doc chapter: "Kitchen Safety & Hankaroon Protocol"
Maya: this thread is officially lore. memorialize it. add to the folklore channel? or keep it sacred in #random.
Liam: sacred in #random. may the legend of the cratered macaron live on. :sparkles:
